sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
A deep cavernous valley north of Mibu Village. The Guardian Ape has made a home here and guards the legendary Lotus of the Palace. According to tradition, the valley's ravines and deep valleys are "appropriate for offering oneself in marriage to the Great Serpent".
Sculptor's Idols:
- Under-Shrine Valley
- Gun Fort
- Riven Cave
- Bodhisattva Valley
- Guardian Ape's Watering Hole

sections.heading: Under-Shrine Valley, Gun Fort
sections.text:
A series of steep cliffs and deep valleys, leading to an old fort in the valley. In the caves of the valley is a shrine, inhabited by the Long-arm Centipede Giraffe, after which is a rope bridge stretching across above a lake.

sections.heading: Riven Cave, Bodhisattva Valley
sections.text:
A cave with a stream running through it below the bridge the Great Serpent destroys, opening into a wide valley lined with giant Buddha statues.
Monkeys make their home in the nearby poison pool that leads to the Sunken Valley Passage that holds the "dried fruit" of the Serpent. In the Bodhisattva Valley resides the lonely Guardian Ape, overlooking the Lotus of the Palace, hoping to attract a new mate.
